name: CHAFFEY, Jamie

headline.note: Private work is identified at Woolworths, Gunnedah Industries and Stripes. Stripes managing-director interval2006–September2024 is supported at mixed precision, but substantive full-time hours remain unknown. Related business spells overlap. Governance, elected office, campaigning, volunteering and study are excluded; totals remain null, not zero.

career_spells.role: Management trainee; later store manager in Gunnedah, Armidale and Maitland
career_spells.evidence_note: Chaffey's first speech says that in his late teens he moved to a nearby town for his first real job, a management traineeship with a supermarket chain. His April 2025 candidate interview names Woolworths, Gunnedah, and later store-manager work in Armidale and Maitland. The exact start/end dates, employment hours and transitions between stores are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is supported, but no exact substantive full-time interval is established.

career_spells.employer: Gunnedah Industries (family business; apprenticeship-era legal entity not established)
career_spells.evidence_note: First speech describes apprenticeship with father-in-law Harold before later ownership. Employer history identifies Harold Hockings and Gunnedah Industries. Its broad2000s joining heading does not resolve apprenticeship dates against the first speech’s28-year business duration. Apprenticeship is separated from later ownership; hours and legal payroll entity unknown. ABR identifies a later Gunnedah Industries trading trust from2000, not the unknown apprenticeship-era employer; do not substitute registration for training commencement.
career_spells.counting_note: The work was privately controlled, but the evidence does not establish a calendar-bounded substantive full-time interval.

career_spells.employer: Gunnedah Chamber of Commerce and Industry
career_spells.evidence_note: Current personal and Nationals biographies identify service as chamber president before election to council. Dates, pay, hours and any overlap with the family business are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: Employer-association activity is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The Nationals biography gives election to council in September 2016, immediate election as mayor, a full term to 2021, and re-election as councillor and mayor in 2021. Chaffey's first speech and current biography state that he served eight years as mayor; his April 2025 interview describes him as the former mayor. Council's 2023–24 annual report says the elected members' fixed term ran until the September 2024 local-government election, and the NSW Electoral Commission dates that election to 14 September 2024. Chaffey did not contest it. End records the fixed-term election boundary; exact commencement day, remuneration and working hours remain unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Elected local-government office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Namoi Unlimited Joint Organisation of Councils
career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies say Chaffey was endorsed as chair in 2018 and re-elected in 2020. The cessation date, remuneration, hours and relationship to his mayoral office are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: This council joint-organisation governance role is treated as attached to elected local-government service and excluded.

career_spells.employer: Country Mayors Association of New South Wales
career_spells.role: Delegate; executive member; deputy chair; chair
career_spells.evidence_note: Council release21November2022 gives delegate since2016, executive since2018, deputy chair since2020 and election as chair inNovember2022. Existing biography gives two years as chair;2024 cessation retained at year precision. Pay/hours and exact transition days unknown. Association honour roll dates deputy chair2021–22, conflicting with council2020 claim; preserve both. Narrandera mayor records successor election at15November2024 AGM, without proving exact earlier cessation. Voluntary capacity described by association, not personal all-duty remuneration proof.
career_spells.counting_note: Association governance is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.role: Regional/Rural Director; Member Value Working Committee member
career_spells.evidence_note: Chaffey's current biography and first speech identify board service. Dates, remuneration, hours and overlap with other local-government roles are unresolved. Follow-up 2 October 2026: council release dated 15 March 2022 says elected earlier that year, supporting 2022 start without an exact date. Annual report 2022–23 identifies Regional/Rural directorship, Member Value Working Committee membership at 30 June 2023, and member-controlled registered employer-association status (refines previous nonprofit category). September 2024 president message announces departure at council-term end; October retrospective confirms vacancy following non-contestation of September elections. End coded September 2024 at month precision, not the announcement date. Director remuneration and personal hours remain unknown; 53 full-time staff in annual report is not evidence about Chaffey.
career_spells.counting_note: Association governance is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The current biography identifies Chaffey as a Graduate of the Australian Institute of Company Directors. Study dates, course load and overlap are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Rotary Club of Gunnedah and Carroll Rural Fire Service
career_spells.evidence_note: His first speech identifies volunteering with both organisations. Dates, duties and hours are not published; the activity is not represented as paid employment.
career_spells.counting_note: Unpaid work is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: In an interview published 30 April 2025 Chaffey said he had campaigned full-time since September 2024. This supports full-time campaign activity, not an assumption of paid employment. Pay, contractual status and the exact September start day are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Party and campaign activity is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen roster establishes House service from 3 May 2025, corroborated by his current biography and first speech. Parliamentary and shadow roles are nested within elected service.
career_spells.counting_note: Elected office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Gunnedah Industries / related family businesses; historical brand registered to Hockings & Chaffey Family Trust, later The Chaffey Family Trust (ABN60 354353214); personal operating/payroll entity still unresolved
career_spells.evidence_note: First speech reports28years in family business before handover to children. This duration is not back-calculated; operational handover is distinct from continuing company ownership/directorship. Exact ownership start, operating end and hours unresolved. Primary ABR resolves a historical Gunnedah Industries trading entity: Hockings & Chaffey Family Trust from23March2000, renamed The Chaffey Family Trust on1February2007. Parliamentary register names Jamie as joint beneficiary of The Chaffey Family Trust and separately shareholder/beneficiary of Gunnedah Industries(NW)PtyLtd. Brand, trust and company must not be collapsed into one payroll entity or ownership interval; no apprentice dates or personal trustee/director appointment inferred.
career_spells.counting_note: Dates, substantive full-time status and/or leave remain insufficiently evidenced; no headline years calculated.

career_spells.employer: Stripes Engineering / Stripes Group (payroll entity unresolved)
career_spells.evidence_note: Company history dates founding Engineering2006, Industrial Supplies2007 and Group consolidation2018.20March2025 report says he led since inception and stepped down the preceding September to campaign, supporting2024-09. Customer publication confirms role25January2015. Neither title nor founder status establishes full-time hours. Related family spells overlap and must not be summed.
career_spells.counting_note: Dates, substantive full-time status and/or leave remain insufficiently evidenced; no headline years calculated.

career_spells.evidence_note: Parliamentary declaration expressly reports resignation as director and cessation as shareholder19August2025. Start unknown; governance/investment is not proof of operational work through that date.
career_spells.counting_note: Excluded category; not added to public/private employment headlines.

career_spells.evidence_note: Chair’s public appointment announcement identifies advisory governance; precise date, remuneration and entity unresolved. Not treated as substantive paid employment.
career_spells.counting_note: Excluded category; not added to public/private employment headlines.

career_spells.evidence_note: Public appointment biography identifies regional chair role. Dates, pay and contractual terms unknown; association governance excluded. Primary16May2024 AGM minutes thank outgoing chair Chaffey and elect Russell Webb as successor. End date records the observed chair handover at that meeting; original appointment date, formal legal cessation, pay and hours remain unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: Excluded category; not added to public/private employment headlines.

career_spells.evidence_note: Own indexed post explicitly reports completion28years earlier and later family-business involvement. Relative recollection not converted into course or apprenticeship start/end. Training provider and formal qualification level remain unknown; not automatically TAFE NSW.
career_spells.counting_note: Study excluded; linked apprentice work already separately recorded, no duplicate paid duration.

research_notes: The frozen official roster contains no occupation entries for Chaffey, so the initial timeline was reconstructed from his first speech, current biography, a contemporaneous candidate interview, the Nationals biography and a council record.
The first speech's stated 28 years in the family business was retained as evidence but not reverse-calculated into calendar dates.
Full-time campaigning describes activity intensity; without payroll evidence it is not coded as full-time employment.
All potentially countable private-sector spells remain uncounted because exact dates and substantive full-time status are unresolved.

Systematic follow-up2026-10-01 identified family business through its own history, split apprenticeship from ownership, added Stripes management and later corporate resignation, and omitted advisory/association governance. Repaired mixed date precision for campaigning and expanded Country Mayors chronology.

Preserve apparent chronology tension: company site places joining under2000s, while first speech gives28years before handover. Neither licenses an exact apprenticeship start. September2024 operating departure and19August2025 corporate resignation concern different capacities. Company group branding and payroll legal entities remain distinct unresolved questions.

Searched official biography/first speech, company history, customer publications, parliamentary interest index, council records, public professional posts and local business reporting. APH PDF403 and council timeout were source-specific; public indexed primary material and open sources supplied evidence. No personal full-time contract or leave evidence found. Gunnedah Gateway and investment-company holdings are follow-up leads, not automatically paid jobs. Spouse directorships must not be attributed to Chaffey.

Second follow-up 2 October 2026 materially dates LGNSW governance 2022–September 2024 and resolves association type from its annual report. These excluded roles overlap business and elected office; no headline employment duration added. Council March 2022 release additionally confirms Namoi chair re-election and CMA deputy-chair election but does not redefine original starts.

Targeted Woolworths/apprenticeship/profile searches did not establish personal employment dates or hours. Namesake overseas corporate profiles excluded. LGNSW 2021–22 report web fetch timed out; 2022–23 PDF downloaded and text-read successfully. Top-five remuneration and overall staff numbers not transferred to Chaffey. Further leads: Woolworths training/payroll history, apprenticeship registration, business leave/operational transition and individual director remuneration.

Further2October pass: rechecked company timeline against traineeship/apprenticeship and2006 founding queries. Stripes2006/2007/2018 milestones and store locations are already captured. Company2000s joining claim still conflicts with first-speech elapsed-tenure implication; no registration or payroll record resolved it.1991 residence description does not establish a Woolworths appointment date. No material addition; defer generic Woolworths/Stripes biography searches pending original apprenticeship, contract or leave evidence.

Third follow-up 2026-10-04: targeted Woolworths store-history, apprenticeship, Gunnedah Industries and Stripes managing-director searches repeated the first speech, candidate interview, company timeline and September 2024 handover already recorded. No apprenticeship registration, Woolworths appointment, individual hours, leave or legal payroll entity was found. No material enrichment counted; retain the company-timeline conflict and advance pending an original training, contract or personnel record.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Primary Murray Darling Association Region11 AGM minutes establish outgoing chair handover to Russell Webb on16May2024, resolving an undated governance endpoint at day precision as a meeting milestone. The minutes explicitly thank Chaffey as chair and record successor election/acceptance; appointment date, formal legal cessation and personal remuneration remain unknown. Subsequent ordinary meeting lists Webb as chair and Chaffey attending as Gunnedah mayor. Apprenticeship-year query yielded no training record. Next: original apprenticeship registration, Woolworths personnel record, business contracts/hours and association appointment instrument; governance excluded.

Follow-up2026-10-05: primary ABR historical trading-name table resolves Gunnedah Industries trust entity and2007rename; primary parliamentary index links member’s joint-beneficiary interest. Retain personal payroll/apprentice boundaries unresolved and separate later company. Namoi council primary index reports23November2023resolution to discontinue activities from31December2023 and seek dissolution by30June2024; audit says Governor approval still required, so no unsupported chair end/dissolution assumed. Tamworth original release open403, individual source gap; original instrument/minutes remain leads. Woolworths/apprenticeship searches yielded existing biography without dates/hours.

Second targeted pass adds omitted completed boilermaker trade-certificate study from own public-indexed post, leaving provider and dates unknown instead of subtracting28years. Association honour roll exposes deputy-chair2021–22 versus council2020 discrepancy; November2024 mayoral report dates successor election as AGM observation, not exact personal resignation. Namoi dissolution searches again supply proposals, not final instrument. Original social posts Online fetch throttled, source-specific; no same-route retry or controls bypass. Store/apprentice personal hours still unknown; preserve null totals.

Third targeted pass2026-10-06 resolves the council/mayoral fixed-term end to14September2024 by combining Council's annual-report statement that the term ran until the September election with the NSW Electoral Commission's exact election day. Chaffey did not contest the election. This is an elected-office boundary, not a business/campaign payroll date; September business handover and campaign start remain month precision. Exact2016 commencement day, hours and remuneration remain unknown.
